_comment: Canonical source of truth for LORE status/entity vocabularies. Consumed by drift-checks in all three packages (backend JUnit LoreStatusesConsistencyTest, frontend+MCP via scripts/check-lore-statuses.mjs). Change here first, then update the mirrors — CI fails on drift.
_statusMatchComment: SPRINT_QG_REBUILD/QG-13. A SECOND axis, deliberately separate from the ones above: planStatuses/statusRaw say what may be WRITTEN, statusMatch says how free text is READ back. status_raw is free text after the marker ("✅ MERGED — ветка влита"), so recognition needs its own vocabulary — and that vocabulary had drifted into three independent copies (Java classifyStatus, the SQL predicate in LoreSlices, taskTick in lore-status.ts). MERGED was known to two of three, ЗАКРЫТ to one, and the SQL demanded ЗАВЕРШЁН strictly with Ё. Cost: one sprint with no completion date and seven tasks counted as open (QG-06). Words are matched ANCHORED at the start, never as a substring: measured 2026-08-26, the whole corpus holds exactly ONE markerless value ("DONE", 1 sprint + 7 tasks), so the word layer exists for eight rows and must not also swallow "NOT DONE". Note: `high` is absent on purpose — it shares the 🔴 marker with `blocked` and is not separately recognizable from free text. Mirrors: LoreStatusVocabulary (guarded by LoreStatusesConsistencyTest) and lore-status.ts taskTick (guarded by scripts/check-lore-statuses.mjs).
